input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position on its material terms: 24.1 lets Customer assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (with notice only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld; 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control. Section 13.3 carries Customer's licence-transfer right through to permitted assignments. The only shortfall from preferred wording is that the competitor bar in 24.2 is limited to a "direct" competitor and is subject to Customer's consent rather than absolute; since any Vendor assignment already requires our consent, this is a minor sub-element noted for information only and not a redline. No change-of-control trigger anywhere else in the document gives Vendor a termination or repricing right.
